entities.summary: Paul was a high-ranking Roman official or soldier in the 5th century, with the rank of comes, freely translated as count. As a historical figure, he is difficult to place because the information that has been preserved about him is unclear. In addition to a comes Paul who operated in Gaul, there is also a comes Paul in Italy, the brother of Orestes. It is possible that this is one and the same person.
